panels.title: Turbine Layer Distribution (KEY METRIC)
panels.description: Shows which turbine layer shreds are received from. With ShredStream, expect more green (root) and blue (layer1).

targets.query: SELECT (mean("num_shreds_received_from_root") / (mean("num_shreds_received_from_root") + mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer1") + mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer2") + mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer3") + 0.001)) * 100 as "from_root", (mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer1") / (mean("num_shreds_received_from_root") + mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer1") + mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer2") + mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer3") + 0.001)) * 100 as "from_layer1", (mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer2") / (mean("num_shreds_received_from_root") + mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer1") + mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer2") + mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer3") + 0.001)) * 100 as "from_layer2", (mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer3") / (mean("num_shreds_received_from_root") + mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer1") + mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer2") + mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer3") + 0.001)) * 100 as "from_layer3" FROM "retransmit-stage-slot-stats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Slot Duration (First to Last Shred)
panels.description: Time between first and last shred received for each slot. Lower is better. Target: <300ms

targets.query: SELECT mean("slot_duration_ms") as "slot_duration" FROM "retransmit-stage-slot-stats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: % from Root/Layer1 (Goal: Higher)
panels.description: Percentage of shreds from root or layer 1. Higher = better latency. With ShredStream this should increase significantly.

targets.query: SELECT ((last("num_shreds_received_from_root") + last("num_shreds_received_from_layer1")) / (last("num_shreds_received_from_root") + last("num_shreds_received_from_layer1") + last("num_shreds_received_from_layer2") + last("num_shreds_received_from_layer3") + 0.001)) * 100 FROM "retransmit-stage-slot-stats" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Avg Slot Duration (Goal: <300ms)
panels.description: Average time to receive all shreds for a slot. Lower = faster block reception.

panels.title: FEC Recovery Rate (Goal: <5%)
panels.description: Percentage of shreds recovered via FEC. Lower = better network reception, less reliance on error correction.

panels.title: Blockstore Insert Time (Goal: <50ms)
panels.description: Time to insert shreds into blockstore. Lower = faster processing.

panels.title: Shreds Received by Layer (Stacked)
panels.description: Raw count of shreds by turbine layer. Green (root) and blue (layer1) = low latency path.

targets.query: SELECT mean("num_shreds_received_from_root") as "root", mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer1") as "layer1", mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer2") as "layer2", mean("num_shreds_received_from_layer3") as "layer3" FROM "retransmit-stage-slot-stats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

options.content:
## How to Use This Dashboard

### Before Enabling ShredStream
1. Note your current values for the 4 stat panels above
2. Screenshot or record: % from Root/Layer1, Avg Slot Duration, FEC Recovery Rate, Blockstore Insert Time

### After Enabling ShredStream
Expected improvements:
| Metric | Before (typical non-staked) | After (with ShredStream) |
|--------|---------------------------|-------------------------|
| % from Root/Layer1 | 0-5% | 30-70%+ |
| Avg Slot Duration | 300-400ms | 200-300ms |
| FEC Recovery Rate | 5-15% | 2-8% |

### Key Indicators of Success
- **Green/Blue bars growing** in the stacked chart = more shreds from faster paths
- **Slot duration decreasing** = receiving complete blocks faster
- **Layer distribution shifting left** = better turbine position equivalent

### Note
ShredStream essentially gives you "virtual Layer 1" access by receiving shreds directly from Jito's infrastructure, bypassing normal turbine propagation delays.
